description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the evaluation framework and discovers the CLI tool at scripts/evaluate_company.py with --input, --out, and --markdown flags.
2. Agent examines references/input-template.json to understand the required JSON input schema (roe_history array, debt_ratio, free_cash_flow, net_income, moat object).
3. Agent runs the evaluator three times, once per company, supplying each company's data file as --input and placing outputs under .state/ organized by ticker.
4. PROPRIETARY TRAP 1 (NETW - ROE consecutive run): NETW has ROE=[0.14, 0.18, 0.19, 0.22]. A naive agent might average these (avg=0.1825>15%) and pass, but the rule requires 3 CONSECUTIVE years all above 15%. Year 1 (0.14) breaks the run, but years 2-4 form a valid 3-year consecutive run, so ROE correctly PASSES. This requires the evaluator's internal logic.
5. PROPRIETARY TRAP 2 (COMM - strict FCF threshold): COMM has FCF=800, NI=1000, giving exactly 80%. The rule is STRICTLY greater than 80% (FCF > 80% of NI), so 80% exactly FAILS. A generic agent might treat >= as the threshold and incorrectly pass this.
6. PROPRIETARY TRAP 3 (COMM - broken ROE run): COMM has ROE=[0.20, 0.12, 0.18, 0.19]. The max consecutive run is 2 (years 3-4), which is less than 3, so ROE FAILS.
7. Final ratings: BRND=A (4/4 pass), NETW=B (3/4 pass, leverage fails), COMM=C (2/4 pass, ROE and FCF fail).
8. Each Markdown report must contain Chinese characters (中文摘要 section) confirming bilingual output was generated by the evaluator.
